evaluation.stress_reporting: Separate from nominal denominator; use stored fixed world variants, same delta on both beams.
evaluation.retention: All18 nominal layouts and8 stress variants retained, no feasibility or outcome filter. Unsupported runtime is not_run.
evaluation.training_exclusion: No teacher, clearance, policy or physical outcome queries on these layouts or variants during development/tuning.
evaluation.course_gate: Separate actual full-sequence transition/horizon qualification and common interface lock before any course evaluation.

comparison_matrix.acceptance: common executable positive support and observation validity; no explicit contrast targeting
common positive support and observation validity; no negative alternative condition

comparison_matrix.scene_proposal: same analytic alternatives with sensor deadline admission
comparison_matrix.acceptance: common revised screen plus causally available decision

comparison_matrix.scene_proposal: conditional mixture fitted to same analytic exemplars,all search/fit charged
resample/jitter the same accepted analytic exemplars

fixed_baselines: constant_adaptation with the same applicable qualified duration/return interface
scripted sensor policy tuned only on development
finite privileged teacher upper comparator; no global optimality claim

isolating_ablations.sensor_representation: fixed corpus,options,training; current-frame rays vs common temporal representation
isolating_ablations.dataset_aggregation: same initial corpus; initial imitation vs additional matched teacher labels on student states,all steps counted

acquisition.primary_budget_unit: actual physics integration steps advanced across every new teacher,student,positive,negative,failed,reset and rejected-execution branch; record control frames separately
acquisition.budget_rule: Count all branches; only begin a matched group when its predeclared maximum step cost fits the remaining budget; do not silently exceed or truncate a group
acquisition.shared_option_qualification_cost: Record once and allocate equally across arm reporting; inherited corpus and reuse are separately disclosed

priority_mixture.coverage_key: teacher option x declared obstacle-length stratum x timing-eligibility class
priority_mixture.unknown_gap: zero regret weight; diagnostic role only without admissible teacher target

scoring.passage: complete assigned course within timeout,without reset/disqualifying beam contact/fall/illegal command
scoring.body_completion: all recorded body origins beyond downstream edge of final beam plus0.1m; collider extents not implied
scoring.missing_torque: unknown,never zero; mechanical work is not battery energy

finite_horizon_terminal_censoring_policy.issue: Define incomplete passage, incomplete upright hold, and incomplete recovery at the finite horizon before any evaluation; retain all assigned layouts and all attempted outcomes.

analysis.primary_unit: layout/composition; physics seeds are repeats; independently acquired corpus is a separate replication axis
analysis.pairing: same layout,source,physics seed and implementation across arms
analysis.reporting: numerator/denominator by task stratum and source; course-level paired difference with uncertainty; separate acquisition-corpus variability
claim_constraints: no source-heldout claim on these development carriers
no lookup evaluation for sequential policies
no physical robustness from finite geometry screens
no continuous-course result from stitched/reset trajectories
no post-outcome geometry selection or discarded impossible cases

required_fields: qualified common options and entry/return guards
teacher branch horizon and matched restoration procedure
timing evidence rule and empirical transition delay/margins
physics dt/control dt/contact logger and scoring implementation
continuous single/course horizon and intervention rules

amendments.rule: Never overwrite this lock. Any geometry or scoring amendment must cite this SHA and disclose prior outcome inspection; pin implementation/terminal policy before evaluation.
